picker.folderTitle: Choose a folder for your Idea Matrix file
picker.folderTip: To open a folder, tap or click it twice. Once only selects it.

overview.title: Score your project ideas
overview.intro: Idea Matrix is a place to keep your project ideas, at whatever stage they are, and to explore which ones deserve your time.

scoring.title: How an idea is scored
scoring.text: Each idea gets a value of 1 to 5 for Reach, Impact, Profitability, Vision and Ease. Together they give its Potential: how good it could be.

confidence.title: Confidence counts the evidence
confidence.text: A separate score for how much evidence sits behind those numbers, from gut feel to a customer commitment. Score is Potential × Confidence ÷ 5, so nothing ranks high until real people have backed it up.

private.title: Private by design
private.text: Your ideas stay yours on purpose. There are no accounts and no server: your matrix is one file in your own storage, and nothing leaves your computer. You do not have to take the app’s word for it. Watch the browser’s Network tab, or read the open-source code.

overview.ai: Use it here in the browser, or connect it to your AI assistant and work through your ideas in conversation.
overview.momTest: talk about people’s lives, not your idea; ask what they did, not what they would do; only a commitment counts as proof.
overview.momTestFrom: The rules for what counts as evidence come from The Mom Test: {{momTest}}

connectAi.title: AI assistant
connectAi.pitch: Score and discuss your ideas from Claude or another assistant, through a small MCP server that runs on this computer.
